summary: Iteration 2 focused on the NEW admin panel (auth + admin CRUD + uploads). Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_api.py (login/me/logout/refresh, wrong-password 401, admin auth guards for services/bookings/upload/clinic PUT, clinic edit+restore, services full CRUD lifecycle, review edit+restore, gallery add+delete, /api/admin/bookings, image upload -> /api/files/{path} round-trip, non-image rejected). Legacy suite test_dentistree_api.py had one stale assertion (expected 6 reviews, seed has 4) — fixed the test. Frontend: full admin UI flow verified end-to-end via Playwright — wrong-password error toast, successful login, all 6 tabs present, ClinicTab tagline edit persists (verified via /api/content and reflects on public /), Services add/edit/delete, Reviews edit+restore (Hitesh Malhotra text preserved), Gallery add+delete, Bookings tab shows 4 rows, Logout returns to login form and /api/auth/me returns 401. All test data restored (tagline back to 'Cultivating Smiles', Hitesh review text restored). No admin-panel bugs found.

minor.issue: Still PUBLIC (unauthenticated) — the review request states it was moved to /api/admin/bookings, but server.py:354 still exposes list_bookings() without auth. Bookings contain PII (name, phone, DOB). Should be removed or auth-gated.

No file-size guard before reading — file.read() loads the whole body into memory before the 10 MB size check. Enforce with an upstream limit or streamed check. Also, when a non-image extension has no '.', ext defaults to 'png' which is fine but unrelated.
Accepts arbitrary dict (no Pydantic model). Whole clinic object is overwritten — a partial PUT could wipe fields. Consider a ClinicUpdate Pydantic model or PATCH semantics.
No Pydantic validation on create/update — any shape is accepted (e.g. rating='abc' on a review). Add per-collection models.

action_items: Decide fate of public GET /api/bookings — either delete it (as the story implies) or add get_current_user dependency. It leaks PII today.
Add Pydantic models for admin create/update payloads (services/doctors/reviews/gallery + clinic) so bad shapes are rejected with 422 rather than silently stored.
Consider migrating deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') to FastAPI lifespan context (still throws DeprecationWarning; not blocking).
SameSite=Lax + Secure=False cookies are fine for the current same-origin preview deployment; before production, flip secure=True and consider SameSite=Strict for the admin session.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:354 — public /api/bookings still exists despite the story saying it was moved to /api/admin/bookings. PII leak; fix before production.

server.py:281 admin CRUD accepts raw dict payloads (payload: dict). Any client can inject arbitrary fields (including ones not in the schema) which are then stored verbatim. Add Pydantic models per collection.
server.py:243 upload_image reads entire body then checks 10 MB — a malicious client can force server to buffer up to whatever the ingress allows. Prefer content-length pre-check.
server.py:135 set_auth_cookies uses secure=False — safe for the current preview (HTTPS terminated at ingress, cookies still transmitted) but for production must be secure=True.
seed_data on line 392 already correctly re-hashes password when it changes — good, matches the auth playbook.

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is spec-invalid; browsers will refuse credentialed requests from any cross-origin caller. Currently the frontend and backend share origin so it works, but if the domain ever changes, cookie-based auth will break. Set CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit frontend URL.
No refresh-token rotation on /auth/refresh — same refresh token remains valid the whole 7 days; consider rotating.
GET /admin/{col} uses `col` from the path with a whitelist check — good, prevents mongo collection injection.
